description: Every push to main builds new latest images that auto-updating installs pick up within minutes, so nothing is automerged: every update is a PR to review and merge by hand. Updates are grouped and opened weekly; security fixes come in immediately.

packageRules.description: Python and npm minor/patch updates: one PR per week
Base images in the Dockerfiles (python, node, nginx): one PR, also for minor bumps such as Python 3.13 to 3.14
GitHub Actions: one PR, majors included
